scope: Actual bundled emulator, physical snapshot service, real ROM execution and lifecycle in inherited mock DOM; no visual/browser/device validation.

results.name: Default-off history adds no frame storage or per-frame subscriber work
Forward works with recording off, stays paused, and does not implicitly enable history
Back restores complete physical state and forward reuses recorded future without executing CPU
Re-executing from restored state produces the same CPU, APU, trace and video
Navigation preserves ROM, project and APU callbacks while clearing host audio and live controls
Existing Frame retains held-key behavior and branches after a rewind
Starting Run after rewind discards recorded future without restarting ROM state
The 300-state cap evicts oldest snapshots and reports the actual retained range
Stored-byte cap evicts snapshots before 32 MiB and reports a shorter window
Unknown current function state rejects restoration atomically and clears unusable history
Successful load isolates sessions while rejected headers retain current history
Reset reseeds, CPU instruction tracing invalidates, and project unload clears history
Large forward requests yield and can be canceled without additional frames
Inputs pressed during a yielded seek stay blocked until completion without removing other blockers
New loads during a yielded seek cannot apply the previous ROM future
Disabling history releases its storage and rejects invalid navigation distances
